layman_headline: Market is running hot after a massive rally — patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just surged 21% in a week and the entire market followed. Our Solana position is up 7.6% and approaching its profit target of $100. XRP is down 5.8% after we entered near the top of its 46% weekly spike, but it's still well above our stop-loss. Every swing candidate on the watchlist has already moved 30-78% in a week, making new entries very risky at these levels.
layman_action: Hold both current positions. SOL is close to its $100 target — consider taking profits if it gets there. Watch XRP closely since it's underwater; if it drops toward $1.30, cut losses. Don't chase any of the coins that have already pumped this week.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates show negative composite scores (-3.0 or worse) due to extreme 7-day moves (33-78%), elevated Fear & Greed at 73 trending toward greed, and high BTC dominance at 59.2% suppressing alt-season dynamics. Without RSI/MACD data on candidates, entering after such parabolic moves violates core swing trading discipline. SOL at $93.85 is 6.5% from its $100 exit target and benefits from institutional inflows. XRP at $1.47 is -5.8% from entry but has a defined stop at $1.30 (11.6% below current), and the Treasury buyback narrative could provide further legs. No new position offers a favorable risk/reward when everything has already moved 20-78% in a week.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 73 and rising — historically a mixed signal (53% win rate) that often precedes sharp corrections
BTC dominance at 59.2% means capital is concentrating in Bitcoin, limiting alt upside potential
XRP entered near a local top after a 46% weekly surge — could retrace significantly if momentum fades
watch_list: SOL price action near $95-100 resistance zone — take profits if exit target is hit
XRP holding above $1.35-1.40 support — prepare to cut if it breaks below $1.30 stop
Fear & Greed index — if it pushes above 80, risk of a broad market pullback increases significantly
market_context: Bitcoin rallied 21% in a week to $77K on Treasury buyback and curve control speculation, dragging the entire market higher. The Fear & Greed index is at 73 (Greed) and climbing, suggesting the easy gains may be behind us and caution is warranted.
context_banner: Broad market euphoria after a historic weekly rally — managing existing positions takes priority over chasing extended moves.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 73 (Greed) and trending up from 61.6 weekly avg — historically a 53% win rate signal, suggesting caution rather than aggressive new entries.
Wall Street poured ~$90M into altcoins including SOL, XRP, and HYPE — the most reliable news source in our credibility data (67% win rate) supporting current holdings.
XRP's biggest weekly gain in 21 months driven by Treasury buyback and curve control hopes — provides fundamental backing for holding the XRP position despite being underwater.
All swing candidates already moved 30-78% in 7 days with no RSI/MACD data available — chasing these moves historically has only a 56% success rate.
Bitcoin's 23% rally attributed to US debt policy shifts and Ray Dalio recommending Bitcoin — macro tailwind supports holding but not adding at extended levels.
